sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI

findings.why: The proposed yellow chromate passivation (COAT-ZN-YELLOW) contains hexavalent chromium (CrVI), which is legally restricted in automotive markets. The current COAT-ZNNI uses CrIII instead. None of the documents gives the legal text or names the part's market, so the legal restriction rests on general knowledge. Please confirm it.

sources.quote: Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: The supplier SUP-G has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of CL-115, the part in this change. The NCR concerns hardness, not the coating. It is still open under this rule.
